name: Phone media player for Podcasts
author: wizard
description: Wizard phone app (Android, and iPhone): Music and Podcasts play through the phone's own media player. Lock-screen and Control Center / notification controls, headset buttons, the episode's artwork and a progress bar you can drag; it keeps playing with the screen locked, and saves your place as it goes. Podcasts gets back 15 / forward 30 buttons, and the player opens the app that is playing. Only Music and Podcasts get this.
